description: Enter one or more musical lanes together in an atomic edit.

content.description: Give each lane a whitespace-separated content string. Use Eb4, F#5 or C###4 for pitches (up to three # or b), d36 for a drum key (0 through 127), r for a rest, and [C4 E4 G4] for a chord. Use [C4~ E4] for selective ties and ~ after a note or chord for a full tie (rests and graces cannot be tied). Duration suffixes are :w :h :q :e :s :32 :64 (whole through 64th), with up to two dots (:q. or :h..), or positive fractions such as :3/8 whose reduced denominator is a power of two up to 1024 (use tuplets for triplets). Main events default to :q. Use | to check a measure boundary and 3:2(A4:e G4:e F4:e) for an actual:normal tuplet. Attach before-graces as acciac(D5) appog(E5) grace4(F5) grace16(G5) grace32(A5) before a main chord and after-graces as after8(D5) after16(E5) after32(F5) after it. Each grace accepts a single note or bracketed chord and an optional duration suffix. Numbered kinds default to and require the reciprocal of their number (1/4, 1/8, 1/16 or 1/32). The two unnumbered kinds default to 1/8 and accept any standard note value up to 1/4.
